description: Search the AI Collection directory for AI tools matching a query. Returns a ranked list with name, URL, and short description. Use this for 'find me a tool that does X' requests.

category.description: Optional category linkName to scope the search (e.g. 'image-generation').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Free-text query to match against application names and descriptions.

name: search_tools
